name: lamp

frames.best_why: Frame 6 has the lamp glow at full width with the headline fully faded in beneath it.

tagline: A cyan lamp glow beams down onto a headline in a dark panel.
summary: A deep navy panel with a bright cyan lip and a soft cone of light fanning downward over a centred headline. On entering view the light widens and the words rise and fade in.
appearance: A deep navy-black panel with a thin bright cyan line near the top and a soft cyan cone of light spilling down from it like a lamp. Below the light, a two-line grey headline sits centred, fading darker toward its lower line.
behaviour: As it enters view the lamp cone and its bright lip widen from narrow to full over about a second, while the headline drifts up and fades in just after. Both settle and stay still; the pointer does nothing.
demo_content: The headline "Build lamps / the right way".
search_phrases: cone of light from the top of a hero
cyan glow behind a quote section
light shaft on a dark banner
glowing cone at the top of a page
theatre light effect for a landing page
use_when: A dark hero needs a single elegant light source to frame a short headline.
avoid_when: You need strong text contrast, or an effect that keeps moving after it loads.
customise: children is the headline or whatever sits under the light, and className styles the container. The cyan palette, cone widths and timings are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A handful of blurred cyan gradient layers animated once into view.

a11y.note: The lamp widens on view with no reduced-motion check, and the headline comes from the demo.

issues: The headline is soft grey on near-black, so its second line nearly disappears.
The lamp only animates once on entering view and is static afterwards.
polish_why: A clean, convincing lamp glow; the low-contrast grey copy beneath it is the small flaw.
title: Lamp
